# Aayan Cotton Industries

> Aayan Cotton Industries (ACI) - Pakistan's premier medical devices and absorbent & non-absorbent cotton wool rolls manufacturer since 2000. Exporting to 20+ countries worldwide.

## Overview
Aayan Cotton Industries (ACI) is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, CE, and GMP certified medical devices manufacturer located in Okara, Punjab, Pakistan.

## Products & Specialties
- Absorbent Cotton Wool Rolls
- Non-Absorbent Cotton Wool Rolls
- Orthopedic Undercast Padding (Ortho Cure, Casto Ban, Ortho Comfort, Ortho Soft)
- Surgical Dressings & Gauze Swabs
- Industrial Cotton Slivers & Disposable Medical Clothing

## Contact & Location
- Location: Depalpur Road, Okara, Punjab, Pakistan
- Official Website: https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/
